subject: Data Engineering
title: The Future of Streaming
description: A fast breakdown of The Future of Streaming for builders.

hook.text: Streaming was once reserved for tech giants. Now serverless streaming runs on a credit card.

buildup.text: Managed services, low-code platforms, and embedded streaming are making real-time accessible to all.

discovery.text: Streaming databases let you write SQL queries that update results continuously as new events arrive.

twist.text: The line between batch and streaming is blurring. Unified engines process both with the same code.

climax.text: The future isn't choosing batch or stream. It's a single engine that handles both transparently.

punchline.text: Batch and streaming are converging. The winner is simplicity.

quiz.question: What trend is reshaping streaming data systems?
options: Unified engines that handle both batch and streaming
Replacing all databases with message brokers
